name: KAISER 4 WB

real.trim: 510 PS RWD, 8-speed M Steptronic; fan-made widebody build (cosmetic)

specs.notes: The widebody is a fan-made concept with no data, so the stock G82 M4 Competition from BMW's spec sheet (03/2021) is used: 510 PS (375 kW) at 6,250 rpm, 650 Nm from 2,750 to 5,500 rpm, 1,725 kg DIN unladen (EU 1,800 kg), rear-wheel drive, the 8-speed's ratios with a 3.154 final drive, 2,857 mm wheelbase, 250 km/h limited (290 with the M Driver's Package). No weight distribution or drag figure was published: 52 % front and Cd 0.36 on 2.2 m^2 (the wider body) are estimates.

garage.blurb: The big-grilled M4 on a fan-made widebody: the twin-turbo six, all of it to the rear wheels, and arches wide enough to hide a drift angle.

interior.notes: The model's (the G82's): dash, carbon buckets, the M wheel with paddles (cut out of the dash by box); left-hand drive. An automatic: the hands stay on the wheel.
